items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: Ben Mulligan's had the saloon grabbing in that part... Ben had liquor there that's like, nah.

ctx.x: Yeah. He liked his drum time. Much easier to get along with, too.

I said, well, alright, now, now we got together. Ori gets together. Ori, get the boys together. If the horse going, oh, the floor is going. Horse, I'll go. Horse going. Ori, we get to the place, listen at this now. Ben Mulligan's had the saloon grabbing in that part. In the back, at a supper. And it was prohibition during that time, but Ben Mulligan, a big politician in the parish prison right around the corner, next block. Ben had liquor there that's like, nah. He had anything he wanted.
